tasks.text: Which shape is named 부산 콜아웃, what is its anchor, and what is its text? Answer as `ANSWER: <anchor> | <text>`.

Write a new workbook with exactly one sheet 메모, range A1:D8, containing: a table 메모표 on A1:B3 with columns 지역 (text) and 상태 (text); a shape named 경고 anchored C2:D3 text "목표 미달"; a group named 등 of two shapes, 녹 at C5:D6 text "녹" and 적 at C7:D8 text "적". No other items.
Add a shape named 대구 콜아웃, anchored B26:D28, with text "대구 3곳, 전년 대비 +4%". Do not change 서울 콜아웃.
Move 부산 콜아웃 so its anchor is E22:G24. Keep its text "목표 미달". Do not edit the note that also says 목표 미달.
Change the text of 부산 콜아웃 to "목표 달성". Do not edit the note that says 목표 미달 (잠정).
Resize 서울 콜아웃 so its anchor is B18:E21. Keep its text.
Connect 서울 콜아웃 to 부산 콜아웃 with an elbow connector, and give 수도권 배지 a drop shadow.
